stories.headline: AI reviews the work. Who reviews [the AI?]
stories.sub: Nvidia reinstates its CEO, Anthropic lets agents approve code, and a survey shows AI agents reviewing the code they wrote themselves.

stories.headline: Nvidia brings Jensen Huang back after [11 days.]
stories.fact: The board voted unanimously, six days after ruling out his return. The independent investigation opened on November 8 is still running.

stories.headline: Claude Ship lets AI agents [approve] code changes.
stories.fact: Teams write their approval policy in natural language as a file in the repository. Anthropic recommends observe-only mode first.

stories.headline: 42 state AGs fight the sale of [private chats.]
stories.fact: Character.AI's bankruptcy auction on December 1 covers chat histories from more than 21 million US accounts, say the attorneys general.

stories.headline: OpenAI's chief scientist proposes [common limits.]
stories.fact: Jakub Pachocki suggests perplexity as a shared yardstick between labs. The post concedes it is hard to compare across labs.

stories.headline: [47%] let AI agents review their own code.
stories.fact: Only 14% have consistent review standards for AI code. LeadDev survey of 377 respondents, sponsored by CodeRabbit.
